claim: Madisonville Christmas Company opened a seasonal Plano pop-up at 5801 Preston Road in 2026 (press release dated 2026-10-12).
quote: In 2026, the company expands with a seasonal Plano, Texas, pop-up at 5801 Preston Road, bringing a curated version of the experience to the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
title: Madisonville Christmas Company press release (Webull/ACCESS Newswire)

claim: The Plano pop-up was running Santa photos 10am-2pm on Saturday 2026-10-17, so it was open by mid-October 2026; regular hours not stated.
quote: photos with Santa (Madisonville from 12pm-4pm and Plano from 10am-2pm)
title: Madisonville Christmas Company press release

claim: The press release describes the Plano pop-up as a curated selection of holiday decor, gifts and inspiration; it does not state that artificial trees are sold there.
quote: discover a curated selection of the brand's holiday décor, gifts and Christmas inspiration
title: Madisonville Christmas Company press release

claim: CultureMap said the Plano store would open in September 2026, in the building it identified as the former Weir's Furniture at 5801 Preston Rd.; the company gave no address.
quote: eagle-eyed viewers of the announcement reel easily identified the building as the former Weir's Furniture store at 5801 Preston Rd., Plano.
title: CultureMap Dallas

claim: Calloway's Nursery and Cornelius Nursery (DFW and Houston) say they sell artificial 'lifelike' trees alongside real ones.
quote: Calloway’s Nursery and Cornelius Nursery have a wide selection of real trees and lifelike trees.
title: Calloway's Christmas Trees page

claim: Decorator's Warehouse, 3708 W. Pioneer Pkwy, Arlington TX 76013, is listed by the Arlington CVB as having over 130 styles of lifelike pre-lit Christmas trees.
quote: you'll find over 130 styles of lifelike pre-lit Christmas trees
title: Arlington CVB listing: Decorator's Warehouse

claim: Decorator's Warehouse's own site lists store hours Mon-Sat 10am-6pm, Sun 11am-6pm at 3708 West Pioneer Parkway, Arlington (page undated; self-reported).
title: Decorator's Warehouse blog

claim: Decorator's Warehouse says its Enchanted Forest has more than 130 tree types, from snow-tipped to pre-lit, in a 60,000+ sq ft store (self-reported).
quote: visit our Enchanted Forest and discover more than 130 different types of trees, ranging from snow-tipped to pre-lit trees
title: Decorator's Warehouse blog
